```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))

ga <- CURRENT_GA
```

```{r}
# Load data
bills <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
people <- read_csv(ga_csv("people", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
sponsors <- read_csv(ga_csv("sponsors", ga), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  left_join(people)

# Load bill groups (graceful degradation if not yet generated)
bill_groups_path <- file.path(ga_paths(ga)$bills, "groups.rds")
if (file.exists(bill_groups_path)) {
  bill_groups <- read_rds(bill_groups_path)
} else {
  bill_groups <- tibble(
    bill = character(),
    status = character(),
    group_status = character(),
    group_size = integer(),
    lead_bill = character()
  )
}

n_bills <- nrow(bills)
```

```{r}
# Header
div(class = "ia-hero-row",
  div(
    h1("Legislation"),
    HTML(sprintf(
      "<p class='ia-lead'>The %s has introduced <strong>%s</strong> bills and resolutions.</p>",
      ga_label(ga), format(n_bills, big.mark = ",")))
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Bill type breakdown (compact abbreviations)
bill_types <- bills |>
  mutate(
    abbr = case_when(
      str_detect(bill_number, "^HF")  ~ "HF",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^SF")  ~ "SF",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^HSB") ~ "HSB",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^SSB") ~ "SSB",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^HJR") ~ "HJR",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^SJR") ~ "SJR",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^HCR") ~ "HCR",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^SCR") ~ "SCR",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^HR")  ~ "HR",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^SR")  ~ "SR",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  count(abbr, name = "count") |>
  arrange(desc(count))

# Status summary (individual vs group)
status_order <- names(STATUS_LEVELS)

has_groups <- nrow(bill_groups) > 0

if (has_groups) {
  status_summary <- bill_groups |>
    count(status, name = "count") |>
    mutate(status = factor(status, levels = status_order)) |>
    arrange(status)

  group_status_summary <- bill_groups |>
    count(group_status, name = "count") |>
    mutate(group_status = factor(group_status, levels = status_order)) |>
    arrange(group_status)

  status_pairs <- status_summary |>
    rename(ind = count) |>
    left_join(group_status_summary |> rename(grp = count),
              by = c("status" = "group_status")) |>
    transmute(label = as.character(status), ind, grp = coalesce(grp, 0L))
}
```

```{r}
# Recent bills header
div(class = "ia-card-head",
  div(class = "ia-card-title", "Recent bills"),
  span(class = "ia-card-sub", style = "margin-bottom:0",
       paste("Most recent activity ·",
             str_squish(format(max(bills$last_action_date, na.rm = TRUE), "%B %e, %Y"))))
)
```

```{r}
recent_bills <- bills |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date)) |>
  head(8) |>
  left_join(bill_groups |> select(bill, bill_status = status),
            by = c("bill_number" = "bill")) |>
  mutate(
    display_status = coalesce(bill_status, status_desc),
    short_title    = vapply(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title, character(1))
  )

rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(recent_bills)), function(i) {
  div(class = "ia-recent-row",
    div(class = "ia-recent-bill", HTML(format_bill_link(recent_bills$bill_number[i], bill_dir_href(ga, up = 1)))),
    div(
      div(class = "ia-recent-title", recent_bills$short_title[i]),
      div(class = "ia-recent-meta",  recent_bills$last_action[i])
    ),
    status_pill(recent_bills$display_status[i]),
    div(class = "ia-recent-date", str_squish(format(recent_bills$last_action_date[i], "%b %e, %Y")))
  )
})
div(class = "ia-recent-list", rows)
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
Browse all `r format(n_bills, big.mark = ",")` bills
:::
::: {.ia-card-sub}
Search all bills, or filter any column: type "HSB" under Bill for study bills, or a name under Primary sponsor. An asterisk (\*) on group status indicates the group has progressed further than this individual bill.
:::

```{r}
# Get primary sponsor for each bill
primary_sponsors <- sponsors |>
  filter(position == 1) |>
  select(bill_id, sponsor_name = name)

all_bills <- bills |>
  left_join(primary_sponsors, by = "bill_id") |>
  left_join(
    bill_groups |> select(bill, bill_status = status, group_status, group_size),
    by = c("bill_number" = "bill")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 1)),
    chamber = case_when(
      str_detect(bill_number, "^H") ~ "House",
      str_detect(bill_number, "^S") ~ "Senate",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    display_status = coalesce(bill_status, status_desc),
    group_status_display = case_when(
      is.na(group_status) ~ NA_character_,
      group_size == 1 ~ group_status,
      group_status == display_status ~ group_status,
      TRUE ~ paste0(group_status, "*")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date)) |>
  transmute(
    bill_number,
    bill = str_replace(bill_number, "^([A-Z]+)(\\d+)$", "\\1 \\2"),
    title = vapply(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title, character(1)),
    chamber, sponsor_name, display_status, group_status_display, last_action_date
  )

# Links, pills and dates are drawn by one JavaScript function per column, so
# the page carries 4,000+ rows of data, not 4,000+ rows of markup. (gt's
# per-cell styles had made this page 7.7 MB.)
bill_link_js <- reactable::JS(sprintf(
  "function(cell) { return '<a href=\"%s' + cell.row.bill_number + '.html\">' + cell.value + '</a>' }",
  bill_dir_href(ga, up = 1)
))
# Mirrors status_pill() in R/legislature/ui_helpers.R
status_pill_js <- reactable::JS(
  "function(cell) {
     const s = cell.value || '';
     const type = /signed|^adopted/i.test(s) ? 'signed' : /vetoed/i.test(s) ? 'vetoed' :
                  /passed/i.test(s) ? 'progress' : 'neutral';
     return '<span class=\"ia-pill ia-pill-' + type + '\">' + s + '</span>';
   }"
)
date_js <- reactable::JS(
  "function(cell) {
     if (!cell.value) return '—';
     return new Date(cell.value).toLocaleDateString('en-US',
       { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
   }"
)

reactable::reactable(
  all_bills,
  columns = list(
    bill_number = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
    bill = reactable::colDef(name = "Bill", minWidth = 80, sortable = FALSE,
                             html = TRUE, cell = bill_link_js),
    title = reactable::colDef(name = "Title", minWidth = 300, sortable = FALSE,
                              filterable = FALSE),
    chamber = reactable::colDef(name = "Chamber", minWidth = 85),
    sponsor_name = reactable::colDef(name = "Primary sponsor", minWidth = 150),
    display_status = reactable::colDef(name = "Status", minWidth = 150,
                                       html = TRUE, cell = status_pill_js),
    group_status_display = reactable::colDef(name = "Group status", minWidth = 150),
    last_action_date = reactable::colDef(name = "Last action", minWidth = 110,
                                         filterable = FALSE, cell = date_js)
  ),
  defaultSorted = list(last_action_date = "desc"),
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```
